predictions: 17-6 last week (with another match dumped to forfeit) was my second strong week in a row. 36-11 for a two-week span is pretty killer, given all the random factors (well, random to me) that pop up in most weeks in these matches. That brings me to 146-68 (68.2% correct) for the season, and I'm on the upswing. I'm even up to 15-12 in B division, and I wasn't sure I would get back above 0.500 in that division at any point. Gotta keep the momentum going… help me out, B and D…

Match of the week: (F Div.) Dart Knights @ The Dartifacts. Unless somebody takes an upset later (which is certainly possible, of course), the F division regular season title will be decided tonight. These two are two matches ahead of anybody else, and are 15-1 combined when not facing each other. Both teams have a couple super big guns, but I think I like the overall balance of The Dartifacts just a touch more. 13-11.

Match #2: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ Darty Sanchez. Menace (and even still Dirty Darts) is still right in this race. But for now, this pairing determines who is running the show in D. Sanchez hasn't lost since this matchup seven weeks ago, when it went to a tiebreaker. And it kinda sorta seems like that's where this is going again… Possee in 1001.

Match #3: (B Div.) Raging Bulls @ Why So Serious? There are FOUR head-to-head matches between members of the FOUR-team group leading B. Obviously, every one of those is critical in determining who wins B (and likely moves to A next season). Big battles ahead… And this is the two who start with a small point edge. Raging it is, 13-11.

Match #4: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Darty Little Secrets. The C race is… almost as great as that B race up above. It actually has five teams in the hunt instead of four, but here everybody is chasing Wing. That means instead of a fight for the lead here, this could be the first of many elimination matches. I'm gambling the Secrets have everybody, 13-11.

Match #5: (E Div.) Waddle In, Waddle Out @ Runs with Corks. With the Bottoms going bottoms up last week, the E race might be an actual race now. Due to the Bottoms' point lead size, the Corks might be a bit far out though. Doesn't mean they can't play spoiler. Cork, 13-11.

Match #6: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Sharky's Machine. What race is better/closer/more dramatic than the race for the E crown? The one being waged by the bottom half of E to avoid those dreaded bottom- two spots! Four teams with the same record, separated by only 13 points. Making their own high drama here. Machine takes it, 14-10.

Match #7: (D Div.) Irish Ton @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Menace just dropped out of the lead trio in D, and now if they want to stay close and relevant to the title fight, they better handle business in sneaky dangerous pairings like this one. They do, but barely, again. 13-11.

Matches #8 & #9: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ That's What She Said; Shark Shooters @ Nein Mark. It's likely that two F teams will be in G next season, and if so, one of these four teams will be one of them. Sofa and She Said already have a match on the other two, so the winner of that one is probably safe. But the loser of the other match will have some work to do. She Said, 13-11; and Nein Mark, 15-9.

Match #10: (A Div.) Fringe Prime @ Darty Minds. Is there really a chance this match could play a role in determining if Fringe ends up in a bottom-two spot in A? That seems almost unfathomable. I think Fringe just has to regroup a bit, and this is the first step, 14-10.

Match #11: (B Div.) The Outlaws @ Double In Stumble Out. While The Outlaws aren't facing one of the other 5-3 B leaders, it's matches like this one that could throw a wrench into the works if a team doesn't pay attention. Outlaws win it with their doubles, 14-10.

Match #12: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Throw It hasn't actually played and beaten someone since week 5. But Salute hasn't actually played and beaten someone since week 2. Throw It needs this to keep any slim title hopes. They win, 14-10.
And the remaining 12 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Element 19, Consistent 5; Show Me 14, Dart Attack 10.
B Division: Kids Mis-B-having 14, Mulligan's Mafia 10.
C Division: Wing 15, Village Idiots 9; Bandits 14, Rif Raf 10.
D Division: Wonders 14, Constantly 10; Dirty Darts 14, Rangers 10.
E Division: Cheap Shots 15, Bangin 9; Bottoms Up 15, Rippin 9.
F Division: Death Throw 16, She-nanigans 8.
G Division: Flight Club 17, Game 7; Dartness 17, Bright side 7.
